mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_set_account_dtl ( flow_dtl_no, store_id, account_type, flow_no, biz_type, order_date, fun_code, amount, cur_balance, fund_direction ) VALUES
( #{item.flowDtlNo}, #{item.merchantNo}, #{item.accountType}, #{item.flowNo}, #{item.bizType}, #{item.orderDate}, #{item.funCode}, #{item.amount}, #{item.curBalance}, #{item.fundDirection} )
mapper.select: select #{dto.merchantNo} as merchantNo, #{dto.accountNo} as accountNo, #{dto.accountType} as accountType, #{dto.startDate} as startDate, #{dto.endDate} as endDate, sum(case when dtl.fund_direction = 'C' then dtl.amount else 0 end) as totalCredit, sum(case when dtl.fund_direction = 'D' then dtl.amount else 0 end) as totalDebit, sum(case when dtl.fund_direction = 'F' then dtl.amount else 0 end) as totalFreeze, sum(case when dtl.fund_direction = 'U' then dtl.amount else 0 end) as totalUnfreeze, count(1) as transactionCount from t_set_account_dtl dtl where dtl.store_id = #{dto.merchantNo} and dtl.account_type = #{dto.accountType} and dtl.order_date between #{dto.startDate} and #{dto.endDate} and exists ( select 1 from t_set_account_flow f where f.flow_no = dtl.flow_no and (f.in_account_no = #{dto.accountNo} or f.out_account_no = #{dto.accountNo}) )
